purpose: Eight-role-family anchor batch used to prove visual diversity and v0.2 anti-AI quality before expanding to the complete 64-type C01D development artwork set.

entries.pose_composition: stable three-quarter seated working posture, attention on an ordinary adjustment task rather than posing for camera
entries.scene_direction: A plausible daytime shared room with a used table and a few everyday objects being quietly aligned or adjusted. The scene should feel inhabited rather than curated. Several lightweight background connection cues may exist, but they must read as normal room details rather than symbolic nodes.

entries.pose_composition: low stable kneeling or crouched working posture beside a small practical assembly
entries.scene_direction: An ordinary apartment utility corner or balcony storage area. The subject is assembling or repairing one simple household object with a compact toolkit. One strong shared-detail anchor should imply an important connection without adding a staged second character.

entries.pose_composition: standing half-turn over a table, comparing several ordinary samples before choosing a direction
entries.scene_direction: A plain community room or reading table with a small number of physical samples, labels or printed references. Comparison is visible through ordinary behavior, not detective iconography. Lightweight connection cues are distributed through separate items on the table.

entries.display_name_ja: 構想の独立検証者〈深縁〉
entries.pose_composition: side-on standing posture with one hand holding a small reference object and the other marking a comparison
entries.scene_direction: A garage entrance, covered porch or simple utility table near daylight. A portable measuring/reference object and a few independently marked comparisons suggest verification without implying a credentialed profession. One or two strong shared-detail anchors carry the D treatment.

entries.pose_composition: active standing movement while arranging a small shared setup, photographed from an ordinary room height
entries.scene_direction: A multipurpose community hall before use: folding furniture, a modest board and a few modular objects being arranged. The subject is actively making the shared structure usable. Broad relation is suggested by several practical connection points, not by a crowd or extroversion cues.

entries.pose_composition: floor-level three-quarter posture actively joining a simple structure, with off-axis framing
entries.scene_direction: An ordinary moving-day or home rearrangement scene. The subject is assembling a simple shelf, frame or modular object. One shared component entering from outside the main frame may serve as the deep-relation anchor without making the scene sentimental or hierarchical.

entries.display_name_ja: 開拓の検証設計家〈広縁〉
entries.pose_composition: forward-moving candid composition through a real public circulation space, subject not centered
entries.scene_direction: A public library, civic building or transit-adjacent interior with ordinary wayfinding and reusable materials. The subject compares two practical layouts or routes while moving. A mobility aid is represented neutrally because of catalog rotation only. Broad relation appears through several ordinary environmental anchors.

entries.display_name_ja: 開拓の探究設計家〈深縁〉
entries.pose_composition: mid-action turn between an existing object and an open doorway or next work area
entries.scene_direction: A small garage, back room or ordinary maker corner with one partly rebuilt everyday object and a simple hand-drawn structural reference. The subject is moving to test the next alternative rather than posing. A hearing device is represented neutrally because of catalog rotation only. Deep relation is carried by one or two strong shared-detail anchors.
